display.purpose: The name across the hero and the footer 'Say hello'; uppercase, fitted to full width.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the services list; uppercase.

title.purpose: Project names, case-study section headings, contact card title; uppercase.

lead.purpose: Hero role line, about prose, case-study lead.

label.purpose: Navigation, tags, captions, metadata, form labels, data panels; sentence case, no tracking.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for presses, hovers, entrances and image drift.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback: scale(0.97) on buttons, 0.98 on tiles.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Section entrances; content visible without JS; reduced motion removes movement.

components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--ink, #141826); color: var(--bg, #f5f6f8); font-family: 'Red Hat Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.1; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--blue, #0f5fa6); color: #fff; } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #0f5fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding-bottom: 3px; color: var(--ink, #141826); font-family: 'Red Hat Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: currentColor; transform-origin: right; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(0); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #0f5fa6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; display: block; width: 320px; height: 240px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0 var(--radius, 6px) var(--radius, 6px) 0; background: var(--green, #2f7a3b); } .ds-shot { position: absolute; top: 9%; left: 7%; width: 86%; height: 110%; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--bg, #f5f6f8); transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-frame:hover .ds-shot { transform: translate(-1.2%, -1.2%) scale(1.015); } .ds-frame:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #f4c20d); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A cool, well-lit bench with the work laid out on it. The ground is near-white and the ink is indigo-black; colour arrives only as whole flat fields borrowed from the projects themselves: the Arduino Uno's blue, the L298N driver's red, the DC motor's yellow, CocoaCare's green, and Aso & Thread's etu night. Each field is a place (a section, a project frame, the contact card, the footer), never a glow, a gradient or a decoration.

Type does the shouting. Red Hat Display at weight 900, set in tight uppercase, carries the name, section titles and the closing "Say hello" at poster scale; Red Hat Text carries everything read. Between the two there is generous air: sections are separated by large vertical gaps, and projects are shown as one oversized framed visual beside a compact text cluster, not as a card grid.

Proof is presented as interface: real screenshots inside coloured frames, wiring diagrams multiplied onto pale tints so their white paper disappears, and small white data panels holding the real report numbers and parts lists. Surfaces are flat at rest; motion is quick, eased-out, and confined to state and entrance.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white ground, indigo ink, four project-derived saturated fields plus etu, used as whole areas.
Red Hat Display 900 uppercase for display; Red Hat Text for reading.
One radius (6px) for nearly everything; flat fills, no shadows.
Large asymmetric 12-column compositions with oversized media.
Work shown as real artefacts: screenshots, multiplied diagrams, white data panels.

rules.name: The Whole Field Rule
rules.body: A saturated colour appears as a complete flat area that owns a section or frame, or as a small solid mark (dot, bar, button). Never as a glow, gradient, tinted shadow, or border accent.

rules.name: The Paired Ink Rule
rules.body: Every field has one fixed ink: white on blue, red and green; indigo on yellow; etu paper on etu night. Focus rings switch to motor yellow on any dark field.

rules.name: The Borrowed Palette Rule
rules.body: New fields come from a project's own hardware or interface, not from a colour wheel.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display is 900, uppercase, tightly tracked; text is sentence case with zero tracking. Never set Red Hat Text in caps, and never letterspace small labels.

rules.name: The Tabular Proof Rule
rules.body: Every number that comes from a report, price or quantity uses tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Flat Bench Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If an element needs separation, give it a different flat ground, not a shadow.

dos: Do give every saturated colour a whole area or a solid mark, with its fixed paired ink.
Do keep a single 6px radius on all new containers, controls and media.
Do set display type in Red Hat Display 900 uppercase with negative tracking, and reading type in Red Hat Text sentence case.
Do show proof as real artefacts: screenshots in coloured frames, diagrams multiplied onto tints, numbers in white data panels with tabular numerals.
Do confine hover effects to `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and give every animation a reduced-motion fallback.
Do use the ease-out curve `cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)` with a 160ms press scale of 0.97.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glows or gradients; separate with flat grounds.
Don't arrange projects as a grid of identical cards; give each its own oversized frame.
Don't put a small uppercase or letterspaced label above a heading.
Don't reuse the order builder's sanyan, etu-square or alaari styling outside that embedded panel.
Don't draw borders around containers; the only rules are the 1px rows inside data panels.
